examples.en: The storm rendered the road useless.
examples.ar: العاصفة جعلت الطريق غير صالح للاستخدام.

examples.en: The update rendered the app faster.
The flood rendered the house unsafe.
The virus rendered the computer useless.
The law was rendered void by the court.
examples.ar: القانون جُعل باطلًا من قبل المحكمة.

examples.en: The injury rendered him unfit to play.
The noise rendered the speech hard to hear.
